svg.title: Every proposed theme on the camera screen
svg.desc: The camera screen in each proposed theme of issue 138: Standard, Hot Pink, Green, Red, Blue, Orange, Purple and Yellow, White, Gray, and an example of custom colors.
svg.text: Appearance themes: the camera in every theme (issue 138)
Two colors make a theme: the background, and one color for text and buttons. The recommended variant of each is drawn; each theme's own file
shows Q, Settings and the viewer, and the alternates. The picture is never tinted. Night Mode is not affected by any theme.
